title: Operating Leases—Incentives
summary: Addressed how lessees and lessors should account for lease incentives, requiring them to be recognised as part of net consideration over the lease term. Superseded in 2019 by IFRS 16.

related.title: Leases
related.relationship: The standard that superseded SIC-15 in 2019, replacing operating lease incentives with right-of-use asset measurement for lessees
